title: spec(view): the any-of filter group still says [PLANNED] and "no console applies it yet" after #28370 landed
body:
domain:skills#1 · os-tesla · session_01L9qibzCtJt8Q2Z63fyRNix

Filing gate: ① published author-facing text states a false status. Found by the contract review of PR #28517 (#28476, record 6553490758, ③.2), outside that PR's scope (spec package). ⛔ Not a claim. Triage sets the grade and lane.

Reach: every author (and AI author) who reads `/meta/types` for a view `filter`, or who writes a MongoDB-form `$or` and gets the parse refusal. Both tell them the any-of group `{ or: [rule, ...] }` is not applied by any console and that a view storing one is refused when it loads. That steers them away from the one shape that works, toward two views or a client-side workaround.

## What `main` says (`efb1620c`)

- `packages/spec/src/ui/view.zod.ts` L1165 docblock heading `## [PLANNED — not yet rendered]`, and the `ViewFilterOrGroupSchema` `.describe` text L1216–1223: "[PLANNED — not yet rendered] … No console reads it yet: until the list query build reads the group, a view that stores one is refused when it loads".
- `packages/spec/src/ui/filter-rule-array.ts` L192–199: the `$or` refusal prose says the group is "declared, but no console applies it yet, so it does not narrow the rows today", and the code comment cites the PLANNED note.

## What `main` does

- #28370 closed with PR #28475 merged: `ui/packages/core/src/utils/filter-converter.ts` (≈L1389–1418) lowers the group to one `['or', ...]` node inside the list's AND; `ui/packages/plugin-view/src/ObjectView.tsx` and `ui/packages/plugin-grid/src/objectGridQuery.ts` send that query; the server filter AST accepts the logical node (`packages/spec/src/data/filter.zod.ts` ≈L2857–2860). The builder saves its OR toggle as one group (`ui/packages/app-shell/src/views/viewFilterFold.ts`), round-trip test `viewFilterOrGroup.roundTrip-28370.test.tsx`.
- `content/docs/ui/views.mdx` § Base filter (PR #28475) and, after PR #28517, the `objectstack-ui` skill already teach the group as live.

## Wanted

- Drop the `[PLANNED — not yet rendered]` marker and the "no console reads it yet / refused when it loads" sentences from the `ViewFilterOrGroupSchema` docblock and `.describe`; state the live behavior in one sentence (a group is ANDed with its sibling elements; the Console builder edits a filter that is exactly one group).
- Drop "(declared, but no console applies it yet, so it does not narrow the rows today)" from the `$or` refusal prose in `filter-rule-array.ts`, and the code comment's PLANNED citation. Update any test that pins the old prose.
- Prose only: `Metadata-protocol: none`, `Clause-②: no`, a patch changeset for `@objectstack/spec`. Any liveness / marker register row that lists this key as planned moves with it.

Reader who acts: the spec lane.

Dedupe (open AND closed): "ViewFilterOrGroupSchema PLANNED" → #28476, #28370 (the renderer card, closed), #26945 (seat post) — none corrects the spec prose; "no console applies it yet" → 1 hit, this text's source. **New.**
